questions.stem: Plants often form new species within a single area when errors in meiosis double their chromosome number. This is:

options.why: That produces similar traits in unrelated species.
Correct. Polyploids are reproductively isolated from the parent species.
Gene flow prevents speciation.
No geographic barrier is involved.

questions.explanation: Polyploids are reproductively isolated from the parent species.

questions.stem: 108 nucleotides are joined into one linear nucleic acid strand by dehydration synthesis. How many water molecules are released?

options.why: Correct. A chain of 108 monomers has 107 bonds, and each bond involves one water molecule.
There is one fewer bond than monomers in a linear chain.

Each bond involves one water molecule, not two.

Sister chromatids separate in mitosis.

questions.stem: A plant cell has a water potential of -0.54 MPa. It is placed in a solution with a water potential of -0.1 MPa. Which describes the net movement of water?
